// Package badstorealiasedimport is a synthetic KNOWN-BAD fixture for
// schemaversion_stamp_gate_test.go's fileRefsQdrantClient (exercised by
// TestFileRefsQdrantClientDetectsAliasedStoreImport) AND
// qdrantClientLocalNames (exercised by
// TestQdrantClientLocalNamesDetectsAliasedStoreImport, 01-REVIEW.md
// iteration-2 WR-01). It imports internal/store under the alias "st" and
// constructs a *qdrant.Client via a direct `c, err := st.NewQdrantClient(...)`
// call — the aliased-import bypass named in 01-REVIEW.md WR-01, gap 2: a
// matcher hardcoded to the literal identifier "store" is blind to this
// shape, so a new allowlist violation in a file shaped like this one would
// previously go undetected. fileRefsQdrantClient must still report true,
// and qdrantClientLocalNames must still bind the client to "c" (the first
// assigned name in the `c, err := ...` shape) so a later write on it would
// still trip TestQdrantClientIsHeldOnlyByStorePackage's write-check.
//
// Deliberately does NOT name the *qdrant.Client type anywhere (no qdrant
// import at all) — the return value is left untyped (`any`) so this
// fixture isolates the aliased-CALL bypass from the pre-existing
// qdrant.Client type-reference check, which would otherwise make this
// fixture pass for the wrong reason.
//
// This file carries a .go.txt extension deliberately: it is parsed from
// source bytes by go/parser, never built by `go build`/gofmt/go vet/the
// linter, so it is not swept by any of them.
package badstorealiasedimport

import (
	st "github.com/seanb4t/engram/internal/store"
)

func dial(host string, port int) (any, error) {
	c, err := st.NewQdrantClient(host, port)
	return c, err
}
